record.question: Who invented telephone?
record.explanation: Answer B: A.Graham Bell. Alexander Graham Bell received the first U.S. telephone patent and is conventionally credited in this kind of question; earlier work and patent disputes make the broad “invented telephone” wording simplified. Reference: https://www.loc.gov/everyday-mysteries/categories/technology/item/who-is-credited-with-inventing-the-telephone. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
